LTP and LTD do not alter the sensitivity of the adenosinergic system.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the inhibitory effects mediated by adenosine on the Schaffer collateral pathway in the hippocampus are maintained during long-lasting modifications in synaptic efficiency.
adenosine is not a major factor in the induction of LTP and LTD, but is a potent neuromodulator in the hippocampus that is maintained during the induction of these synaptic changes.

adenosine is an effective neuromodulator that can modulate the synaptic transmission in a variety of ways depending on its concentration and that it can modulate LTP and LTD without being affected by the synaptic plasticity itself.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the inhibitory effects mediated by adenosine on excitatory synaptic transmission are maintained in the presence, and even after induction, of either long-term potentiation or long-term depression.
adenosine is not a neuromodulatory agent that is only active during normal synaptic transmission.
adenosine can still modulate synaptic transmission in a similar way after LTP and LTD.
